a:r.a:t: Saffron Link citrus export · four destination lanes · 7-day pilot sample · cold-chain telemetry as of 2026-09-24. The pilot reduced median dwell while temperature excursions stayed below the contract limit. The humidity sensor reads 3–5 points high after calibration, so spoilage risk is not fully cleared. Four lanes are too few to claim network-wide savings; treat the activation as a reversible one-week decision.
